description: Wire rewards + coaching into the real flow: ProgressionProvider (clock seam, reward/badge application, pre-write prior capture, new return types, setAiCoaching), the production systemClock, the Result/MasteryResult/Practice/Progress screens, the Result route param, and the smoke-test harness + provider/screen tests. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001/002/003. This is where 'finishing a lesson or passing mastery updates XP/streak/badges EXACTLY ONCE, surviving reopen' is realized.
steps: Create src/ui/rewards/systemClock.ts exporting `systemClock: Clock` as a value: nowEpochMs: () => Date.now(); localDateYYYYMMDD() formats the DEVICE-LOCAL new Date() via getFullYear()/getMonth()+1/getDate(), zero-padded to exactly 8 digits (YYYYMMDD). It lives in the UI layer because it touches the environment; the domain only sees the Clock interface.
Modify src/ui/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx so the Result route param type gains optional practiceAnswer?: string (all other routes unchanged).
Modify src/ui/screens/PracticeScreen.tsx so the Continue CTA always forwards `draft` trimmed and bounded to MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT as practiceAnswer (display/coaching-only; raw text never persisted).

Modify src/ui/context/ProgressionProvider.tsx per design 6.1: add the optional prop seam ProgressionProvider({ children, clock = systemClock }: { children: ReactNode; clock?: Clock }); hold rewards/attemptHistory/aiCoaching from the loaded v2 PersistedData; export interfaces CompleteLessonOutcome { outcome: RewardOutcome; badgeEarned: string | null; priorPracticeAttempt: PriorPracticeAttempt | null } and MasteryOutcome { outcome: RewardOutcome; badgeEarned: string | null; priorByQuestionId: Record<string, PriorQuestionAttempt | null> } (name MasteryOutcome deliberately distinct from the domain MasteryResult and the route param). CHANGE the ProgressionContextValue return types: completeLesson: (trackId, levelId, lessonId, practiceAnswer?) => Promise<CompleteLessonOutcome>; recordMasteryResult: (trackId, levelId, result) => Promise<MasteryOutcome>. Add setAiCoaching(next: PersistedAiCoaching) => Promise<void> (same single-key saveData path). Expose rewards/viewRewards and aiCoaching on the context. deleteAllData resets in-memory state from defaultPersistedData() (full v2 shape), not a v1 literal.

Implement both wrappers as single persisted transactions per the design 6.1 pseudocode. completeLesson: capture priorPracticeAttempt = data.attemptHistory.practice[lessonId] ?? null BEFORE any write; nextProg = completeLessonPure(...); outcome = applyReward(data.rewards, {kind:'lesson-completed',...}, clock); level = resolveLevel(trackId, levelId) using findTrack/findLevel from catalogLookup (returns null on null catalog or stale id); events = level ? deriveCompletionEvents(before, nextProg, level, trackId) : []; badge = applyBadge(outcome.state, events); hadText = practiceAnswer != null && practiceAnswer.trim().length > 0; write the current attempt as the new prior into attemptHistory.practice[lessonId]; persist({...data, progression:nextProg, rewards:badge.state, attemptHistory:next}) in ONE call; return { outcome, badgeEarned: badge.badgeEarned, priorPracticeAttempt }. recordMasteryResult: capture priorByQuestionId for every graded.questionId BEFORE any write; nextProg = recordMasteryResultPure(...); masteryOutcome = result.passed ? applyReward(data.rewards, {kind:'mastery-passed',...}, clock) : null; rewardsAfterXp = masteryOutcome?.state ?? data.rewards; resolveLevel + events + badge = applyBadge(rewardsAfterXp, events); write the current attempt per graded question into attemptHistory.questions; persist once; outcome = masteryOutcome ?? a synthetic zero-XP outcome ({state:data.rewards, xpAwarded:0, alreadyAwarded:false, streakIncreased:false, streakReset:false, newStreakCount:data.rewards.streak.count, badgeEarned:null}); return { outcome, badgeEarned: badge.badgeEarned, priorByQuestionId }. NEVER throw when the catalog is null/stale (XP/streak-only, events=[]).

Modify src/ui/screens/ResultScreen.tsx: call completeLesson(trackId, levelId, lessonId, route.params.practiceAnswer) and read the returned outcome/badgeEarned/priorPracticeAttempt. Render an honest XP line ('You earned 20 XP' first time, 'You have already earned XP for this lesson' on a repeat), the streak line ONLY when outcome.streakIncreased, and drive the existing 'You completed the <level> level.' copy from badgeEarned !== null. Render coachPractice(lesson, route.params.practiceAnswer ?? '', priorPracticeAttempt) (the RETURNED pre-write prior, never live provider state): strength, improvement, hint, and the comparison block only when comparison !== null. REMOVE the now-dead local deriveCompletionEvents/isLevelComplete recompute AND the unused imports `import { deriveCompletionEvents } from '../../domain/rewards'` and the isLevelComplete import from '../../domain/progression' (eslint flags unused imports). Keep write-failure handling (do not claim completion/XP until the write succeeds).

Modify src/ui/screens/MasteryResultScreen.tsx: render the +50 XP line for the FIRST mastery pass only (else 'already earned'/nothing on a fail); render a badge-earned line and the 'You completed the <level> level.' copy from badgeEarned !== null; render per-question coachMasteryQuestion(question, graded, priorByQuestionId[graded.questionId]) from the returned pre-write priors, showing the comparison block only when honestly supported; keep the 'retrying never lowers your best score' note (now also true for XP). REMOVE the dead recompute AND unused deriveCompletionEvents/isLevelComplete imports.

Modify src/ui/screens/ProgressScreen.tsx: add a viewRewards-driven section showing total XP + streak count + earned-badge count under an explicit 'Your effort' label, visually separated from a 'Levels mastered' section; per-level badges render only when hasBadge(trackId, levelId) is true. No fabricated numbers (every value from viewRewards / the existing progression view).

Extend __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx harness (design 8 'Harness extensions'): change mount to mount(routeName, params, { clock }?) forwarding a FakeClock into <ProgressionProvider clock={clock}> (omitted -> default systemClock, so existing call sites keep working); register Result and MasteryResult in ROUTE_COMPONENTS; add a remount(routeName, params, { clock }?) reopen helper that builds a fresh provider tree loading the already-persisted goalie.v1 doc; update the existing Progress tests' stored docs to valid v2 OR rely on the accepted v1->v2 migration.

Add design section 8 items 26-29c to __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx: (26) completing a lesson once awards 20 XP and persists it, and re-running via remount+revisit Result awards no additional XP (ledger idempotency across reopen); (27) a mastery pass awards 50 and earns the level badge exactly once when both lessons are complete, and a failing retry afterward keeps the badge and does not change XP; (28) ProgressScreen renders XP/streak under the effort label and a badge only when hasBadge, with a high-XP/no-mastery state showing '0 levels mastered'; (29) the Focus screen leaves rewards untouched (opening it moves no streak); (29a) incorrect-then-(remount)-correct on the SAME mastery question renders the 'improved'/'last time' comparison copy, while a first-ever attempt renders none (proving the screen reads the returned pre-write prior); (29b) FakeClock('20250131') -> complete lesson -> advance to '20250201' -> complete another credits a consecutive-day streak (count 2); (29c) a wrapper call with a null catalog or a stale id applies XP/streak and returns badgeEarned:null without throwing.
acceptance_criteria: ProgressionProvider accepts an optional clock prop (default systemClock), applies rewards+badges inside completeLesson/recordMasteryResult in a single persisted transaction, returns the pre-write prior attempt(s), and exposes setAiCoaching + rewards/viewRewards + aiCoaching.
Completing a lesson or passing mastery updates XP/streak/badges exactly once and the idempotency survives a remount-from-saved-doc (no second award).

Result and MasteryResult render honest XP/streak/badge lines and coaching from the returned pre-write prior, with the dead local completion-event recompute and its unused imports removed; ProgressScreen separates effort (XP/streak) from mastered levels (badges).
The smoke harness supports clock injection, Result/MasteryResult routes, and a reopen helper; the Focus screen moves no streak.
npm test (full suite) and npm run lint both pass.
verification: npm run lint   clean (confirms no unused imports remain in the screens)
findings:
Implemented the full rewards+coaching wiring. All four verifications green: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test -- screens.smoke = 11 passed; npm test (full) = 131 passed across 11 suites; npm run lint = 0 errors (only the 3 pre-existing require-import WARNINGS for the AsyncStorage jest-mock registration in focus-screen/screens.smoke/store tests; no unused-import warnings remain in the screens).

NEW production clock — src/ui/rewards/systemClock.ts: `export const systemClock: Clock` (also default export). nowEpochMs: () => Date.now(); localDateYYYYMMDD() formats new Date() local components (getFullYear padStart 4, getMonth()+1 pad2, getDate() pad2) to exactly 8 digits YYYYMMDD. UI-layer (touches the environment); domain only ever sees the Clock interface.

RootNavigator — RootStackParamList.Result now: { trackId: string; levelId: LevelId; lessonId: string; practiceAnswer?: string }. All other routes unchanged.

PracticeScreen — Continue CTA forwards practiceAnswer: draft.trim().slice(0, MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT) (import MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT from ../../domain/coaching). Display/coaching-only; raw text never persisted.

ProgressionProvider — NEW exported interfaces/signatures FEAT-005 must bind to (all exported from '../context/ProgressionProvider'):
- interface CompleteLessonOutcome { outcome: RewardOutcome; badgeEarned: string | null; priorPracticeAttempt: PriorPracticeAttempt | null }
- interface MasteryOutcome { outcome: RewardOutcome; badgeEarned: string | null; priorByQuestionId: Record<string, PriorQuestionAttempt | null> }  (name deliberately distinct from the domain MasteryResult and the MasteryResult route param)
- ProgressionProvider({ children, clock = systemClock }: { children: ReactNode; clock?: Clock })  (optional clock seam; default systemClock; captured once and passed to applyReward)
- ProgressionContextValue CHANGED member return types (not Promise<void>): completeLesson: (trackId: string, levelId: LevelId, lessonId: string, practiceAnswer?: string) => Promise<CompleteLessonOutcome>; recordMasteryResult: (trackId: string, levelId: LevelId, result: MasteryResult) => Promise<MasteryOutcome>.
- NEW context members: rewards: RewardsState; viewRewards: RewardsView (computed via viewRewards(data.rewards)); aiCoaching: PersistedAiCoaching; setAiCoaching(next: PersistedAiCoaching) => Promise<void> (same single-key persist path). Also exposes focusSession: FocusSessionRecord | null + setFocusSession(next) => Promise<void> (pre-existing Phase 5 working-tree wiring the provider must satisfy; it only persists the local mirror, never touches progression/rewards).
- deleteAllData resets in-memory state via setData(defaultPersistedData()) (full v2 shape).
- Both wrappers follow design 6.1 pseudocode EXACTLY as single persisted transactions: capture the PRE-WRITE prior BEFORE any write; applyReward for XP/streak; resolveLevel via a private useCallback using findTrack/findLevel from screens/catalogLookup (returns null on null catalog or stale id); events = level ? deriveCompletionEvents(before, nextProg, level, trackId) : []; applyBadge; write the current attempt into attemptHistory; ONE persist() call; return the pre-write prior. recordMasteryResult awards mastery XP only on result.passed, else a synthetic zero-XP RewardOutcome. NEVER throws on null/stale catalog (events=[], badgeEarned:null).

ResultScreen practice-coaching call site (FEAT-005 injects the AI hint HERE): the screen destructures practiceAnswer from route.params and, after a SUCCESSFUL completeLesson write, stores result.outcome / result.badgeEarned / result.priorPracticeAttempt in local state (priorPractice). It then computes `const coaching = coachPractice(lesson, practiceAnswer ?? '', priorPractice);` in the render body (currentAnswerText is exactly route.params.practiceAnswer ?? '', the same value hadText derives from) and renders coaching.strength / coaching.improvement / coaching.hint, plus the comparison block only when coaching.comparison !== null. FEAT-005 replaces coaching.hint (and sets source:'ai') by wrapping/replacing this single coachPractice(...) call — the coaching object is built in one place, from the wrapper-returned PRE-WRITE prior (never live provider attemptHistory). The on-arrival write is guarded by a useRef(didRun) + a `status === 'ready' && track && level && lesson` gate so it fires EXACTLY ONCE per mount (completeLesson is recreated on every persisted-data change; without the guard the effect loops). The Retry button calls markComplete() directly.

MasteryResultScreen — mirrors the pattern: guarded once-per-mount save(); renders +50 XP only on result.passed first pass (else 'already earned'/nothing), streak line only when outcome.streakIncreased, badge + 'You completed the <level> level.' from badgeEarned !== null, and per-question coachMasteryQuestion(question, graded, priorByQuestionId[graded.questionId] ?? null) from the returned pre-write priors with the comparison block (improved -> 'You improved: ', else 'Compared to last time: ') only when coaching.comparison !== null. Kept the 'retrying never lowers your best score / earned XP' note. Removed the dead deriveCompletionEvents/isLevelComplete recompute and their unused imports in BOTH Result and MasteryResult.

ProgressScreen — adds a viewRewards-driven 'Your effort' section (Total XP / Current streak / Badges earned) separated by a divider from a 'Levels mastered' section whose per-level badges render only when viewRewards.hasBadge(trackId, levelId); shows '0 levels mastered' copy otherwise. Empty state only when no effort AND no attempt AND no mastered levels. Removed the now-unused isLevelComplete import.

Smoke harness — __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx: a FakeClock implements Clock (settable date via set()); mount(routeName, params, { clock }?) forwards clock into <ProgressionProvider clock={clock}> (omitted -> default systemClock); remount(...) is the reopen-from-saved-doc helper (alias of mount, since the provider always loads AsyncStorage on mount); Result + MasteryResult registered in ROUTE_COMPONENTS; a v2Doc() seed helper. Added design §8 items 26-29c (idempotent lesson XP across reopen; mastery 50+badge once then failing retry keeps both; ProgressScreen effort/0-mastered; Focus moves no streak; incorrect-then-correct remount renders the 'You improved' copy while a first attempt renders none; FakeClock day-advance credits streak count 2; stale-id wrapper applies XP/streak + badgeEarned:null without throwing via a direct Probe component).
